data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English elements alf 'elf' and wite 'wise' or 'bright'. This name signifies an exalted or wise woman. In the Bible, the name Alveta is not found, but it carries a spiritual meaning of being a chosen or exalted one by God. The name Alveta carries the meaning “Exalted one” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alveta usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
